subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar’s default local share card adopt this token-first, source-aware model-activity narrative while retaining the existing dashboard as the scalable detail surface?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and includes real renderer proof, but the choice of what a public aggregate artifact should emphasize is a durable product and UX contract that tests cannot determine.

options.title: Approve the bounded share-card contract
options.body: Accept this as the default local share artifact, with its explicit partial-coverage and privacy disclosures, while leaving broader dashboard architecture work in the canonical tracker.

options.title: Pause for a narrower artifact direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer merge until the owner specifies a different hero metric, route granularity, or relationship to the broader model-centric view.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded share-card contract
recommendation.body: Accept this as the default local share artifact, with its explicit partial-coverage and privacy disclosures, while leaving broader dashboard architecture work in the canonical tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Owner review and merged adjacent work establish the strongest product and technical context for this decision.
